title: PHP Deserialization and POP Chains
description: Entry-point identification → chain construction → phar variants
detail:
Entry points: unserialize(), magic methods __destruct/__wakeup, session deserialization, phpggc chains.
Tool: phpggc -l to find chains for the corresponding framework (Laravel/Monolog/ThinkPHP...).
Bypassing __wakeup: increase the property count (CVE-2016-7124, PHP < 7.0.10).
phar:// variant: trigger with phar://x.jpg/a.txt at a filename parameter (note restrictions in PHP >= 8).
Java: see the WebLogic/Shiro/FastJSON entries.
Clue: if the source contains a class with __destruct and controllable properties → debug the chain locally with the same PHP version.
